children: Ramkrishna Forgings, a leading player in forged metal products, on Saturday posted a consolidated net profit of  ₹70.59 crore for September quarter FY27, backed by strong revenue growth.
It had incurred a loss of  ₹9.5 crore in the second quarter of preceding 2025-26 financial year, the company said in a statement.
During July-September FY27, revenue rose to  ₹1,405.42 crore from  ₹907.53 crore in the same period a year ago. EBITDA increased to  ₹256.23 crore from  ₹122.54 crore.
During April-September FY27, net profit zoomed to  ₹117.47 crore from  ₹2.29 crore a year ago. Revenue surged to  ₹2,622.09 crore from  ₹1,922.79 crore.

Naresh Jalan, Managing Director, Ramkrishna Forgings said domestic demand remained healthy in Q2, supported by firm commercial vehicle production schedules, and customer activity across key export markets has been resilient.

"Looking ahead, we are building our presence in non-ferrous forgings, including aluminium, titanium, inconel and nimonic grades, for high-technology applications across aerospace, robotics and semiconductors," he said.

title: Ramkrishna Forgings Q2 profit at ₹70 crore
